label: Ferrier Hall Ensemble — several separators in one column
covers: Cells that mix separators inside a single column, and against each other: a semicolon list whose first part contains its own commas, a semicolon list closed with a full stop, a two-sentence cell whose first sentence ends on a quoted phrase, a three-sentence cell, and beside them the cells that must survive whole — a comma list that is one statement, a cell opening 'Avg.', a bracketed aside, and a single semicolon joining a clause to its qualifier. run-on-cells established that the splitter works at all; this one asks whether it still picks correctly when both kinds sit side by side in the same column, which is how real sources are written rather than one shape per document.

columns.heading: INPUTS
items: Instrument hire, sheet music and rehearsal space; a part-time ensemble leader; a termly transport budget
